name: A Very Splendid Otome Game
source:
Please help yourselves to the splendiferous SPLENDIDEST OTOGE. To summarize the game, it's about falling in love with a cake. A very splendid cake. The heroine's name is randomized or optionally set by the player. [From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=20291]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
